values.quickstart:
nix shell 'github:nix-purifiers/cabal-purifier'
cabal-purifier lock
eval "$(cabal-purifier prefetch)"
cabal build
cabal test
values.language_tooling_setup:
`prefetch` preserves your existing GHC, Cabal and language server. It puts a Cabal shim first on `PATH` so build-tool calls use the prefetched locked sources. Start the editor from that environment, or use its `PATH`, and use a language server compatible with your chosen GHC. A `.envrc` with the `eval` line from [Working offline](reference.html#working-offline) supplies the same environment through direnv.

Use `cabal-purifier prefetch --with-toolchain` to explicitly request packaged GHC matching the lock, packaged Cabal, and matching HLS when available. The default CLI and dependency-only prefetch preserve host tools; `cliWithToolchain` is the separate packaged-GHC CLI output.
